summary: Patch-3 backend testing — 36/36 PASS. All 28 regression tests (auth, rooms, host transfer, auto-destroy, creator reclaim, manual transfer, YouTube search, WS basic) still pass. 8 new patch-3 tests pass: /me returns created_at+total_seconds, fresh signup total_seconds=0, ~3s WS session increments total_seconds, multi-session cumulative tracking works, chat image forwards intact, oversize image (>720_000) silently dropped, image-only chat broadcasts, empty/whitespace chat dropped.

minor.issue: Server silently `continue`s on oversize image — no error/ack sent to sender. Client gets no signal that its message was dropped. Consider sending a private `{type:'chat_dropped', reason:'image_too_large'}` back to the sender so UI can show a toast. Functional behavior matches spec ('server silently DROPS') so this is purely UX polish.

No validation that `image` is actually a base64 data URI — server forwards any string ≤720k chars. A malicious client could spam plain text as 'image'. Consider regex `^data:image/(jpeg|png|webp|gif);base64,` validation.

total_seconds is computed with `int(time.time() - start)` and only flushed on disconnect. If process crashes mid-session, those seconds are lost. Acceptable trade-off for now; mentioning for visibility.

created_at is Optional[str] in the model and falls back to .get() — older users seeded before the migration would return null. Pre-seeded testuser1 was created before this field existed; verify backfill or accept null for legacy users.

action_items: (Optional UX) emit `chat_dropped` event back to sender when an oversize image is rejected — currently silent.
(Optional security) validate the `image` field shape (data:image/<type>;base64,...) before broadcast.
(Optional persistence) consider periodic heartbeat flush of total_seconds so a crash mid-session doesn't lose all minutes.
critical_code_review_comments: Hours tracking is well-implemented: connect_time keyed by (room_id, user_id) supports concurrent rooms; $inc is atomic so multi-session accumulation is safe.
Chat image cap of 720_000 chars correctly enforced BEFORE building the payload — no wasted broadcasts.
UserPublic.created_at as Optional[str] handles legacy users gracefully — good.
Both new fields land cleanly in TokenResponse.user (signup/login) and /me. Frontend can read total_seconds from any auth response.
Carry-over from iter-1/2: JWT_SECRET still defaults to ephemeral secrets.token_hex if not in .env — all tokens invalidated on restart. Set JWT_SECRET in backend/.env for prod.
seed_data_creation: Each test signs up fresh TEST_-prefixed users and creates a fresh room. No cleanup; data accumulates in db.users and db.rooms (rooms auto-destroyed on last WS disconnect).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` — should be 36/36 green in ~45s. Test files: backend_test.py (auth+rooms+WS basics), test_patch_iter2.py (auto-destroy + host transfer + YouTube), test_patch_iter3.py (analytics + chat image). BASE URL is hardcoded to https://partyapp-sync.preview.emergentagent.com in each test file (matches EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Hours-tracking test sleeps ~3s and multi-session ~5s — adjust if making test suite faster. Note: Frontend Browser Hub change (UI-only) was NOT in scope and was not tested.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all patch-3 features behave per spec.
